g.aria-label: Ideal objective, intractable since ground-truth ∇log p is unknown
Integration by Parts: E_p[½‖s_θ(x)‖² + ∇ · s_θ(x)] + const
Eliminates ∇log p, but Jacobian trace ∇ · s_θ costs O(d) passes
Noise Regression: ½ E_{x₀,ε}[‖s_θ(x₀ + σε) + ε/σ‖²]
Fast O(1) pass in any dimension d; fits blurred score ∇log p_σ(x̃)
Denoising Score Matching trades O(d) Jacobian traces for a controllable σ-blur bias
